'''Sena Pakkallo''' was a medical [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during and prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During the course of her career, she was posted to a number of undesirable [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and she grew disillusioned by the requirements of her profession. She later defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] after its [[Bakura Truce|intervention]] at [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]].

==Biography==
Pakallo was a medical supervisor. She served on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] [[Reuss VIII/Legends|Reuss VIII]] for a short time, providing hygiene instructions to locals.
